q: By June 30, 2027, the German government decides in cabinet to deploy the Bundeswehr on Ukrainian territory (including for training, air defense, or ceasefire monitoring), or submits a motion seeking approval for such a deployment to the Bundestag
basis: A ceasefire has to come first. The forecast that a full Russia-Ukraine ceasefire holds for at least 30 days by the end of June 2027 stands at 30 percent, and in January the German government opened the door to a post-ceasefire Bundeswehr deployment only as far as NATO territory bordering Ukraine. Any armed deployment of the Bundeswehr abroad requires the prior approval of the Bundestag. This forecast tests whether Germany is moving toward placing its security-guarantee force inside Ukraine.
rs: Announcements of cabinet decisions by Germany's federal government and motions submitted to the Bundestag
